text.tspan: key part 1 of 2, points to Item

svg.text: Improved model (planned, built after the brief's)
Item: one per SKU, so the SKU is unique.
StockRecord: one per SKU per warehouse (the ProductKey).
Item and warehouse meet only through StockRecord,
so there is no many-to-many link.
The brief's Product = one Item + one StockRecord,
Shipment and InventoryMovement keep the brief's fields.
Cost and status are the same in every warehouse;
a status per warehouse is improvement I5.
